svg.title: release-ledger: evidence for the EU Cyber Resilience Act
svg.desc: record: when a release is published, it attaches an SBOM and cra-evidence.json and signs attestations. monitor: daily, every release inside its support period is checked against OSV; when a vulnerability is listed as actively exploited by CISA KEV or ENISA EUVD, it opens an issue with the Article 14 checklist: 24-hour early warning, 72-hour notification, final report.
